# montecarlo_pinecone_credentials (Resource)

Pinecone credentials are the project API key Monte Carlo stores for Pinecone connections to use. The API key is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) API key of the Pinecone project. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `api_key_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `api_key_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `environment` (String) Pinecone environment the project runs in, such as `us-east-1-aws`.
- `project_id` (String) Id of the Pinecone project.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
